official_source_url.value: The official Embassy of Guinea-Bissau in Portugal's visa application page states applicants must 'TRAZER UMA FOTOGRAFIA ACTUAL' (bring one current photograph), with no dimensions, background colour, or other technical specification published.

cross_verification.note: A third-party operator, rgb-visa.com, advertises an 'Electronic Visa Application System' for Guinea-Bissau, but its official government affiliation could not be confirmed (search results explicitly flag it as 'reported to be unreliable') and it is not on a .gw or gov.gw domain, so it was excluded per the government-source-only sourcing policy. A domain 'evisa.gov.gw' referenced in some aggregator summaries failed DNS resolution and could not be reached. No official Guinea-Bissau government page with granular e-visa/visa photo technical specifications (size, background, expression, etc.) could be located.
